notes.title: Version 1.44
notes.content:
Update to the Demo version: 
* Possibility to cancel a fixed point (including an elbow) when building a connection line.
* Possibility to rotate the first section of the connection line.
* Fixed bug - it was possible to leave the game zone.

Update for the Base version: 
* Everything that was improved in Demo version.
* Added alien life, it does not affect gameplay yet.
* Active pause - you can inspect your settlement in pause mode.

notes.title: Version 1.36
notes.content:
The v1.36 update mainly focuses on compatibility with future DLC (HardLanding: Industry: Come out to surface). But even without this DLC, the following was done in the base version:

 Redesigned the interface for buildings
 Added sandstorms and an interface that allows you to watch them
 Displaying the movement of crates on conveyors
 Added a loading bridge to allow crates to be moved across an intersecting conveyor lane
 Improved save/load interface

notes.title: A major update - "Colonial Care"
notes.content:
This is the last major update for Early Access. We're getting ready for the release of the game. This does not mean that the development is stopping, quite the opposite. We will continue to develop the game in different directions with additional downloadable content (DLC). This development strategy will allow the players to modify the game depending on their preferences. For example, we planned to introduce alien organisms into the game, which would turn the game into a Tower Defense game. However, this is not to everyone's liking, many players prefer to play strategy without a direct opponent, focusing on increasing the complexity of industrial chains. Having different DLCs the players will be able to decide how they want to construct their experience!

This update focuses on the story and social side of the game, and the following has been made:

 Introducing a part of the story that will immerse the players into the game world.
 Work on the colonists has begun, each one now has character traits, desires, and demands.
 Introduced a faction system for colonists (they will change faction in response to player decisions).
 Added plot events. Colonists propose and promote their ideas.
 Added tools to monitor the political and material state of the colony.
 Added a system to take the colonist out of the cryo-chamber in several stages, leaving the colonist in a virtual world or providing air and water completely waking them.


When you, as a real leader, start to take care and to wake colonists from cryo-chambers, the game will become more complicated and interesting. We are sure that lack of energy, oxygen and conflicts between colonists will not stop you and you will lead your colony through many crises!

notes.title: Version 1.21
notes.content:
* Visualization of the creation of buildings using drones
* Visualization of the change of day and night

notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
New mode "Free play" 
 New map for the free play "Crater"
 Building construction in free play
 Grader -  surface leveling tool
 Resource mining system
 Construction resources (plasteel and plastoconcrete)
 Construction and laying pipes/cables/conveyors over uneven terrain
 Storage buildings for resources
 Oxygen production
 The ability to save in "Free play"

notes.title: Localization
notes.content:
Added translations into other languages using google translator.

If you are a native speaker of one of the languages supported by Steam and want to help us out to improve the localisation and translate the game to your language, please contact us. Unfortunately we can not offer any compensation, we are a very small team without any funding.
